_note: The libraries shipped as source in third_party/. The version of each is READ FROM ITS FILES ('detect'), so after replacing a library nothing has to be edited here. Only a library without a readable version number (kissfft) has a 'version' written down by hand. Used by tools/check_vendored.py (weekly workflow 'vendored-watch') and tools/make_sbom.py (SBOM of each release). See third_party/README.md. 'readme_*' and 'readme_extra_rows' feed the table in the root README.md (python tools/check_vendored.py --update-readme); the extra rows (not vendored) are written by hand.
